name: PlaceOrder
reading: PlaceOrder: 10 typestates over 10 checker nodes, lookahead 0; 11 rules (the start and one per typestate: in it each next typestate is possible and nothing else is). Faithfulness is decided as one bisimulation check: pass faithful a task or lean to compare a model with this protocol

rules.formula: (and (not (or (after CreateOrder) (after Quote) (after SoldOut) (after Pay) (after Charge) (after Charged) (after Declined) (after Receipt) (after PaymentDeclined))) (not terminal))
rules.name: start
rules.notation: ¬(CreateOrder ∨ Quote ∨ SoldOut ∨ Pay ∨ Charge ∨ Charged ∨ Declined ∨ Receipt ∨ PaymentDeclined) ∧ ¬terminal

rules.formula: (AG (implies (and (not (or (after CreateOrder) (after Quote) (after SoldOut) (after Pay) (after Charge) (after Charged) (after Declined) (after Receipt) (after PaymentDeclined))) #0=(not terminal)) (and (EX #1=(and (after CreateOrder) #0#)) (AX (or #1#)))))
rules.name: typestate 0: (start)
rules.notation: AG ((¬(CreateOrder ∨ Quote ∨ SoldOut ∨ Pay ∨ Charge ∨ Charged ∨ Declined ∨ Receipt ∨ PaymentDeclined) ∧ ¬terminal) → (EX (CreateOrder ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ AX (CreateOrder ∧ ¬terminal)))
